assignmentHint.FORM_FIELD: The user entered in a user field of a form.
assignmentHint.INITIATOR: The person who started the request (e.g. to correct it).
assignmentHint.INITIATOR_MANAGER: Head of the requester's department; if none, the next level up.
assignmentHint.LANE_ROLE: Users with the job role of the lane; several users → a group task they claim.
assignmentHint.PREVIOUS_PERFORMER: Whoever completed the chosen earlier step.
assignmentHint.ROLE: Users with this job role; several users → a group task they claim.
assignmentHint.USER: Always this user (or their out-of-office substitute).

case.cancelHint: Workflow administrators can cancel a request; the requester is informed. Please give a reason.
case.commentPlaceholder: Write a comment — type @ to mention someone
case.purged: The form data of this closed request was removed after the retention period.
case.withdrawHint: The request stops and open tasks are cancelled. Please give a reason.

catalogue.empty: No services you can start yet.
catalogue.subtitle: Start a request: the process routes it to the right people and you follow every step.

codes.APPROVAL_NO_APPROVE_PATH: Approval step: map the outgoing flows to the decisions (at least “Approve”).
codes.APPROVAL_RETURN_UNMAPPED: No flow for “Return for correction”: the decision will not be offered.
codes.BOUNDARY_EVENT_KIND: Only timer and error boundary events are supported.
codes.BOUNDARY_HOST: Timer / error boundary events are supported on user tasks, call activities and automatic steps only.
codes.CONDITION_IGNORED: Conditions on flows out of a parallel gateway are ignored.
codes.CONDITION_MISSING: This flow out of a gateway needs a condition (or make it the default flow).
codes.DECISION_INVALID: The decision table cannot be evaluated: {{detail}}
codes.DECISION_NOT_APPROVED: The linked DMN decision must be approved or published first.
codes.DECISION_NOT_FOUND: The linked decision was not found.
codes.DEFAULT_ON_PARALLEL: A parallel gateway has no default flow.
codes.ERROR_END_NO_CODE: The error end event has no error code.
codes.EXEC_INVALID: The execution settings of this element are damaged: {{detail}}
codes.FORM_EMPTY: The start form has no fields.
codes.LINKED_NOT_EXECUTABLE: The linked process is not executable and deployed.
codes.MULTIPLE_NONE_STARTS: Only one plain start event is allowed (timer start events are fine).
codes.MULTIPLE_POOLS: Only one pool can be executed; split the other pools into their own processes.
codes.NOTIFY_TEXT_MISSING: The notification needs a subject and a message.
codes.NO_ASSIGNMENT: Who does this step? Choose an assignment rule or put the step in a lane linked to a role.
codes.NO_DECISION: Link the business rule task to a DMN decision (Properties tab).
codes.NO_DUE_TIME: No due time or SLA: the task never becomes overdue.
codes.NO_END: The process has no end event.
codes.NO_INCOMING: No flow leads to this element.
codes.NO_LINKED_PROCESS: Link the call activity to a process (Properties tab).
codes.NO_OUTGOING: No flow leaves this element: the path ends here.
codes.NO_START: A plain start event (none or with a form) is needed to start requests.
codes.OUTCOME_NOT_APPROVAL: This flow has an approval decision, but its step is not an approval step.
codes.PREVIOUS_STEP_UNKNOWN: The earlier step “{{detail}}” does not exist.
codes.SERVICE_KIND_MISSING: Choose what the automatic step does (set data or generate a document).
codes.SET_DATA_EMPTY: Add at least one value to set.
codes.SUBPROCESS: Embedded sub-processes cannot be executed: model the steps inline or use a call activity to a linked process.
codes.TIMER_CYCLE_INTERMEDIATE: A waiting timer cannot repeat; use a duration or a date.
codes.TIMER_INVALID: The timer value is not valid: {{detail}}
codes.TIMER_TOO_SHORT: The timer is too frequent ({{detail}}): durations at least 1 minute, repeating timers at least every 5 minutes.
codes.TIMER_TOO_MANY: The timer repeats too often ({{detail}}): at most 1,000 repetitions.
codes.UNSUPPORTED_ELEMENT: This element type cannot be executed — use “{{detail}}” instead.
codes.UNSUPPORTED_EVENT: This event type cannot be executed ({{detail}}). Supported: start (plain, timer), timers, error and terminate end events.

check.ok: The published version can be executed.
check.title: Executable check

config.allowWithdraw: The requester may withdraw a running request
config.delaysHint: Empty: the defaults of Settings → Workflow execution.
config.deployOwnerOnly: Only the process owner and workflow administrators can deploy (it makes the process live for staff).
config.deployedOk: Deployed: new requests use this version
config.enableFirst: Switch “Executable” on and save to offer the process in the service catalogue.
config.enabledHint: Requests can be started from the service catalogue once a published version is deployed. The modeler shows the Execution tab.
config.eventLog: Feed a live event log (process mining)
config.eventLogHint: Every completed step becomes an event in a process mining log: map, variants, conformance and KPIs on real executions.
config.monitorsHint: Besides the process owner and workflow monitors of the process department.
config.pinningHint: Each request stays on the version it started with; deploying a new version only affects new requests.
config.prefixRule: Capital letters and digits, starting with a letter (max. 10)
config.pseudonymise: Pseudonymise performers in the event log
config.retentionHint: Form data, comments and files of closed requests are removed after this period; case numbers, steps, dates and decisions stay. Decide at go-live (personal data).
config.title: Execution settings

dashboard.note: Times are in working hours of the business calendar (working week and public holidays). Only processes you may monitor are counted.
dashboard.subtitle: Requests started and completed, throughput time, SLA compliance per step and workload
dashboard.title: Workflow dashboard

document.includeData: Add a table with the request data

exec.approvalHint: Approval step: the performer approves, rejects or returns for correction (comment required for reject and return). Map the decisions to the outgoing flows.
exec.businessRuleHint: Business rule: the linked DMN decision (Properties tab) is evaluated with the request data; its outputs become request data (e.g. budgetApproval).
exec.callActivityHint: Calls the linked process (Properties tab), which must be executable; the request waits until the called request is completed.
exec.defaultFlow: Default flow (taken when no condition is true)
exec.deployed: Version {{version}} is deployed: new requests run on it.
exec.dueFromSla: Empty: the SLA of the step ({{hours}} working hours).
exec.dueNone: Empty: no due time (set an SLA in the step attributes or here).
exec.errorBoundaryHint: Catches errors of this step with this code (empty: any error, e.g. a failed decision or document).
exec.errorEndHint: Ends the request with this error; a calling process can catch it on its call activity.
exec.fourEyes: Four-eyes: the requester and earlier performers cannot complete this step
exec.fourEyesHint: Use it for approvals so nobody approves their own submission.
exec.interrupting: Interrupting: cancel the step when the timer fires
exec.noLaneRole: The step is not in a lane linked to a role: link the lane to a role or choose another rule.
exec.noUserFields: No user field in the forms
exec.notDeployed: Not deployed yet: publish a version, then deploy it in the process settings.
exec.nothing: This element has no execution settings.
exec.outcomeHint: This flow is taken when the approval step ends with this decision.
exec.selectElement: Select a step, event, gateway or flow to set how it runs.
exec.startFormHint: What the requester fills in when starting a request from the service catalogue.
exec.terminateHint: Terminate end: ends the whole request at once and cancels open tasks.

errors.DUPLICATE_KEY: Another field already uses this name

timer.timeDurationHint: ISO 8601 duration: PT4H = 4 hours, P2D = 2 days, P1W = 1 week.
